actions.action: Check whether the pot has a drainage hole
Finger-test the soil 2-3 cm deep before watering
Scrape off the mold and top 1-2 cm of soil and bag it
Wipe the pot rim with rubbing alcohol
Top up with fresh well-draining potting mix
If no drainage hole, place the plant in its nursery pot inside the decorative pot
Empty water from the saucer or pot bottom after watering
Move the plant to a spot with better air circulation
If roots are rotten, trim the rot and repot in fresh mix

reason: The answer correctly names mold from overly wet soil but mainly advises replacing only the top layer, with a full soil change offered only conditionally, so the advice is partial; nothing in it is harmful.
